winter.title: Winter Heating & Baseline Tariff
winter.desc: Low solar yield (max 1.6 kW) with elevated residential heating load. Battery executes off-peak nighttime charging to shave high evening spot prices (112.80 EUR/MWh).

spring.title: Spring Solar Dip & Negative Midday
spring.desc: Strong rooftop PV ramp crashes wholesale spot tariff to -60.07 EUR/MWh between 11:00 and 15:00. Battery charges from negative grid prices and surplus solar.

summer.title: Summer Solstice Maximum Generation
summer.desc: Peak solar generation across 16 hours of daylight (7.6 kW peak). Battery reaches 100% SoC before solar noon; smart MPC shifts exports to evening peak (134.39 EUR/MWh).

autumn.title: Autumn Transition & Evening Ramp
autumn.desc: Moderate solar (3.2 kW) with sharp evening demand ramp. Two distinct intraday battery arbitrage cycles between morning and evening price peaks (181.28 EUR/MWh).

extreme_high.title: German Dunkelflaute Scarcity Spike
extreme_high.desc: Historic Central European Dunkelflaute cold spell. Spot prices spike to 936.28 EUR/MWh at 18:00. Battery discharges at maximum 5.63 kW inverter capacity, generating massive cost savings.

extreme_low.title: Renewable Cannibalization Crash
extreme_low.desc: Mother's Day renewable oversupply crashes spot market to -135.45 EUR/MWh. Under EEG Section 51, export subsidies are cut; battery absorbs grid power at negative cost.

arbitrage.title: Spring Two-Cycle Arbitrage
arbitrage.desc: Nighttime and midday solar pumping (28 MW) absorbing low-cost energy, discharging at morning and evening price peaks (+115 EUR/MWh).

afrr_surge.title: aFRR Balancing Capacity Activation
afrr_surge.desc: Frequent secondary reserve activations (+25 MW to -20 MW) overlaying commercial schedule to stabilize transmission grid frequency.

wear_stress.title: High Reversal Wear Stress Test
wear_stress.desc: Volatile intraday spread oscillations triggering potential rotor reversals; controller suppresses switching wear penalties (80 EUR/switch).

drought.title: Low Intraday Spread Water Conservation
drought.desc: Narrow 18 EUR/MWh intraday spread; machine stays in hydraulic idle mode to avoid efficiency round-trip losses (76% RTE).

extreme_high.title: Dunkelflaute Scarcity Turbining Surge
extreme_high.desc: Historic German Dunkelflaute price spike; continuous 30 MW maximum turbining generating 185k EUR in evening peak.

extreme_low.title: Negative Market Price Pumping Surge
extreme_low.desc: Negative pricing crashes spot to -135 EUR/MWh; machine operates at full 28 MW pumping load, consuming power at negative net cost.

dimming_event.title: DSO §14a Emergency Dimming Event
dimming_event.desc: Grid operator triggers emergency dimming to 50 kW between 17:00 and 20:00; smart priority scheduling maintains 100% on-time departure.

overnight_depot.title: Unconstrained Overnight Depot Charging
overnight_depot.desc: Smooth off-peak charging curve across 48 commercial vans at low night network tariffs (Module 3).

daytime_turnover.title: Midday Shift Return Solar Soak
daytime_turnover.desc: Midday fleet turnover soaking cheap rooftop solar energy between 11:00 and 14:00 at 0.04 EUR/kWh.

departure_crunch.title: Morning Departure Crunch with Dimming
departure_crunch.desc: 80% of vans departing at 07:00 with DSO grid cap at 75 kW; Earliest Deadline First (EDF) protects departure readiness.

extreme_uncoordinated.title: Uncoordinated Baseline Stampede (B0)
extreme_uncoordinated.desc: Uncoordinated charging creates a massive 380 kW transformer spike exceeding grid connection limit by 52%.

negative_soak.title: Negative Tariff Depot Buffer Charging
negative_soak.desc: Wholesale tariff drops to -135 EUR/MWh; fleet chargers and stationary depot buffer draw maximum power at net rebate.

summer_export.title: Summer High Solar P2P Export Day
summer_export.desc: Midday community generation exceeds total load 3x; internal market trades at feed-in floor with zero external grid imports.

winter_deficit.title: Winter Deficit & External Grid Draw
winter_deficit.desc: Low solar generation forces all 20 members to draw power from the public grid at the standard 32 ct/kWh retail tariff.

cloud_volatility.title: Volatile Cloud Passing & Dynamic Proportional
cloud_volatility.desc: Rapid 15-minute generation swings demonstrate the dynamic proportional sharing mechanism over static quota keys.

negative_day.title: Negative Spot Tariff Producer Protection
negative_day.desc: Public feed-in tariff cancelled by negative spot prices; internal P2P exchange provides 100% of local producer income.

evening_peak.title: Evening Residential Heat & Cooking Ramp
evening_peak.desc: Post-sunset residential cooking surge; community battery discharges to provide cheap local energy against 180 EUR/MWh spot peak.

core_cliff.title: High Network Charge Core Stability Stress
core_cliff.desc: Internal network charge tested beyond break-even (c > 0.110 EUR/kWh); illustrates consumer defection risk.

overplanting_storm.title: Combined Wind Gale & Midday Solar Over-Planting
overplanting_storm.desc: Combined Wind + Solar reaches 68 MW against the 50 MW PCC connection limit; BESS absorbs excess 18 MW, mitigating structural curtailment.

eeg51_negative_run.title: EEG §51 Consecutive Negative Hour Curtailment
eeg51_negative_run.desc: Spot price remains negative for 8 consecutive hours; B3 MPC pauses export to prevent statutory feed-in premium forfeiture.

extreme_high_spike.desc: Zero wind and solar output during cold spell; battery discharges at maximum 10 MW rating directly into +934 EUR/MWh scarcity spike.

bottleneck_grid.title: Severe Connection Bottle-Neck (30 MW PCC)
bottleneck_grid.desc: Tight 30 MW grid connection creates 2.33x over-planting ratio, demonstrating maximum economic battery salvage value.

system_shortage.title: German Grid Shortage & Positive reBAP Spike
system_shortage.desc: Severe German control area undersupply; under-delivery is heavily penalized, shifting optimal newsvendor bid to conservative high quantile (q75).

system_long.desc: Renewable oversupply causes negative reBAP; over-delivery penalized, shifting optimal risk-aware bid to lower quantile (q25).
